mentions.name: Arty
mentions.description: An open-source iOS voice agent that uses the OpenAI Realtime API with a bring-your-own-key setup. It ships with connectors for Hacker News, Google Drive, GitHub, and web search, and runs with local tools (no MCP support yet), staying self-contained except for the OpenAI model and any connected third-party services. Users can request additional connectors via GitHub issues.
mentions.problem: Frustration with the limitations of the OpenAI Realtime Voice iOS app, which cannot connect to services like Google Drive.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built Arty: https://github.com/vibemachine-labs/arty

It's an open-source iOS voice agent that uses the OpenAI Realtime API (bring your own key).

Current connectors: Hacker News (check demo in readme!), Google Drive, GitHub, and web search.

I got frustrated with the limitations of the OpenAI Realtime Voice iOS app—for example, it can't even connect to Google Drive.
